name: Eeler Walt

intro.text: Willow traps in the dyke at dusk, eels in the trap by dawn. Unless you scare them off. Which you are.

win: Slipped through my fingers, that did. Like an eel.
after: Every eel in this dyke was born in the Sargasso Sea, across the Atlantic, and swam here as a glass-clear baby. Then they swim all the way back to breed. Nobody's ever seen them do it.
